title: Speed boost salchiblox scripts
features: Set a speed bost jump boost and more
script:
-- Salchiblox Speed v7 (Clean, Bug-Free, Custom Colors, Discord Link & Locked UI)
if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxGui") then
    game.CoreGui.SalchibloxGui:Destroy()
end
if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxScreenParticles") then
    game.CoreGui.SalchibloxScreenParticles:Destroy()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Config File Setup
local CONFIG_FILE = "SalchibloxSpeedConfig.json"
local baseSpeed, speedMultiplier = 16, 1
local baseJump, jumpMultiplier = 50, 1
local gravityVal = 196

local function loadExistingConfig()
    if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
        local success, data = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
        end)
        if success and data then
            baseSpeed = data.baseSpeed or 16
            speedMultiplier = data.speedMultiplier or 1
            baseJump = data.baseJump or 50
            jumpMultiplier = data.jumpMultiplier or 1
            gravityVal = data.gravityVal or 196
        end
    end
end
loadExistingConfig()

-- Anti-Kick & Basic Anti-Cheat Bypass Hook
pcall(function()
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if method == "Kick" or method == "kick" then
            if self == player then
                warn("[Salchiblox] Blocked an attempt to kick you!")
                return
            end
        end
        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
end)

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SalchibloxGui"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

local ScreenParticlesGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenParticlesGui.Name = "SalchibloxScreenParticles"
ScreenParticlesGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenParticlesGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenParticlesGui.DisplayOrder = -1

-- Main Window (Locked in Place)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 25)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -210)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420)
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
MainStroke.Thickness = 1.5

-- Title Bar
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
Title.BorderSizePixel = 0
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Text = "  ⚡ Salchiblox Speed"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
Title.TextSize = 15
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Instance.new("UICorner", Title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- Close Button ('X')
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Title)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -12)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Text = "X"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 13
Instance.new("UICorner", CloseBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Hide Button ('-')
local HideBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Title)
HideBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 90)
HideBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -12)
HideBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
HideBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HideBtn.Text = "-"
HideBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HideBtn.TextSize = 14
Instance.new("UICorner", HideBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Tab Bar
local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
TabBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 30)
TabBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 42)
TabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)

local function createTabBtn(name, xPos, width)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabBar)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, xPos, 0, 0)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    return btn
end

local Tab1Btn = createTabBtn("Main", 0, 64)
local Tab2Btn = createTabBtn("Speed", 64, 64)
local Tab3Btn = createTabBtn("Jump", 128, 64)
local Tab4Btn = createTabBtn("Visuals", 192, 64)
local Tab5Btn = createTabBtn("Settings", 256, 64)

Tab1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
Tab1Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Content Holder
local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
ContentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 80)
ContentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -80)

local function createScrollingTab()
    local tab = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", ContentContainer)
    tab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tab.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    tab.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 460)
    tab.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    tab.Visible = false
    return tab
end

local Tab1 = createScrollingTab(); Tab1.Visible = true
local Tab2 = createScrollingTab()
local Tab3 = createScrollingTab()
local Tab4 = createScrollingTab()
local Tab5 = createScrollingTab()

local tabs = {Tab1, Tab2, Tab3, Tab4, Tab5}
local tabBtns = {Tab1Btn, Tab2Btn, Tab3Btn, Tab4Btn, Tab5Btn}

-- Dynamic UI Color Application Tracking
local activeThemeColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
local function updateActiveTheme(col)
    activeThemeColor = col
    MainStroke.Color = col
    for j, t in ipairs(tabs) do
        if t.Visible then
            tabBtns[j].BackgroundColor3 = col
        end
    end
end

for i, btn in ipairs(tabBtns) do
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for j, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            t.Visible = (j == i)
            tabBtns[j].BackgroundColor3 = (j == i) and activeThemeColor or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
            tabBtns[j].TextColor3 = (j == i) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
        end
    end)
end

-- UI Controls Builders
local function createSlider(parent, name, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, yPos, callback)
    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos)
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Label.Text = name .. ": " .. defaultVal
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 13
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local SliderBG = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    SliderBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 48)
    SliderBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderBG.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos + 20)
    SliderBG.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 8)
    Instance.new("UICorner", SliderBG).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local SliderFill = Instance.new("Frame", SliderBG)
    SliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
    SliderFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal)/(maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0)
    Instance.new("UICorner", SliderFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateInput(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - SliderBG.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderBG.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * pos)
        SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        Label.Text = name .. ": " .. value
        callback(value)
    end

    SliderBG.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateInput(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateInput(input)
        end
    end)
end

local function createToggle(parent, name, yPos, callback)
    local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
    ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos)
    ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34)
    ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    ToggleBtn.Text = name .. ": OFF"
    ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
    ToggleBtn.TextSize = 13
    Instance.new("UICorner", ToggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local state = false
    ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        if state then
            ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 100)
            ToggleBtn.Text = name .. ": ON"
        else
            ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
            ToggleBtn.Text = name .. ": OFF"
        end
        callback(state)
    end)
end

-- Variables
local noclipEnabled, antiStunEnabled = false, false
local starfallMode, rainMode = "OFF", "OFF"
local auraActive, spinbotActive = false, false

-- Tab 1: Main
createToggle(Tab1, "Noclip", 15, function(s) noclipEnabled = s end)
createToggle(Tab1, "Anti-Stun & Anti-Kick", 60, function(s) antiStunEnabled = s end)
createSlider(Tab1, "Gravity", 0, 350, gravityVal, 115, function(v) gravityVal = v; workspace.Gravity = v end)

-- Tab 2: Speed
createSlider(Tab2, "Base Speed", 1, 500, baseSpeed, 15, function(v) baseSpeed = v end)
createSlider(Tab2, "Speed Multiplier", 1, 100, speedMultiplier, 90, function(v) speedMultiplier = v end)

-- Tab 3: Jump
createSlider(Tab3, "Base JumpPower", 10, 300, baseJump, 15, function(v) baseJump = v end)
createSlider(Tab3, "Jump Multiplier", 1, 100, jumpMultiplier, 90, function(v) jumpMultiplier = v end)

-- Tab 4: Visuals
local rainColors = {Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(50, 250, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 180)}
local rainColorNames = {"Blue", "White", "Green", "Pink"}
local rainColorIdx = 1

local starColors = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255)}
local starColorNames = {"Gold", "White", "Cyan", "Purple"}
local starColorIdx = 1

local function createModeToggle(parent, name, yPos, modes, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.Text = name .. ": OFF"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local idx = 1
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        idx = idx % #modes + 1
        local current = modes[idx]
        btn.Text = name .. ": " .. current
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = (current ~= "OFF") and Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
        callback(current)
    end)
end

createModeToggle(Tab4, "Starfall Effect", 15, {"OFF", "UI", "All Screen"}, function(m) starfallMode = m end)

local starColorBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Tab4)
starColorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
starColorBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 55)
starColorBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
starColorBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
starColorBtn.Text = "Starfall Color: Gold"
starColorBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
starColorBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", starColorBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
starColorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    starColorIdx = starColorIdx % #starColors + 1
    starColorBtn.Text = "Starfall Color: " .. starColorNames[starColorIdx]
end)

createModeToggle(Tab4, "Rain Effect", 90, {"OFF", "UI", "All Screen"}, function(m) rainMode = m end)

local rainColorBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Tab4)
rainColorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
rainColorBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 130)
rainColorBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
rainColorBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
rainColorBtn.Text = "Rain Color: Blue"
rainColorBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
rainColorBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", rainColorBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
rainColorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    rainColorIdx = rainColorIdx % #rainColors + 1
    rainColorBtn.Text = "Rain Color: " .. rainColorNames[rainColorIdx]
end)

createToggle(Tab4, "Neon Character Aura", 165, function(s) auraActive = s end)
createToggle(Tab4, "Spinbot Effect", 210, function(s) spinbotActive = s end)

-- UI Theme Color Selector buttons
local ColorLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Tab4)
ColorLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ColorLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 255)
ColorLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
ColorLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
ColorLabel.Text = "UI Theme Accent Color"
ColorLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
ColorLabel.TextSize = 13
ColorLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local function createThemeColorBtn(name, col, xPos)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", Tab4)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = col
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15 + xPos, 0, 280)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 30)
    btn.Text = name
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        updateActiveTheme(col)
    end)
end
createThemeColorBtn("Purple", Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255), 0)
createThemeColorBtn("Blue", Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255), 72)
createThemeColorBtn("Red", Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50), 144)
createThemeColorBtn("Green", Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100), 216)

-- Tab 5: Settings (Auto-Load, Permanent Save & Discord Copy Button)
local SaveBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Tab5)
SaveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
SaveBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
SaveBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 38)
SaveBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SaveBtn.Text = "Save Current Settings Permanently"
SaveBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SaveBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", SaveBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

SaveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if writefile then
        local data = {
            baseSpeed = baseSpeed,
            speedMultiplier = speedMultiplier,
            baseJump = baseJump,
            jumpMultiplier = jumpMultiplier,
            gravityVal = gravityVal
        }
        writefile(CONFIG_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(data))
        SaveBtn.Text = "Saved Successfully!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        SaveBtn.Text = "Save Current Settings Permanently"
    else
        SaveBtn.Text = "Executor doesn't support writefile!"
    end
end)

local DiscordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Tab5)
DiscordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242) -- Discord Blurple
DiscordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 65)
DiscordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 38)
DiscordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
DiscordBtn.Text = "Copy Discord Server Link"
DiscordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DiscordBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", DiscordBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

DiscordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local discordLink = "https://discord.gg/UGSmvHdGX"
    if setclipboard then
        setclipboard(discordLink)
        DiscordBtn.Text = "Copied to Clipboard!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        DiscordBtn.Text = "Copy Discord Server Link"
    else
        DiscordBtn.Text = "Clipboard not supported!"
    end
end)

-- Particle Spawner Loop
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.08)
        if starfallMode ~= "OFF" then
            local targetParent = (starfallMode == "UI") and MainFrame or ScreenParticlesGui
            local star = Instance.new("Frame", targetParent)
            star.BackgroundColor3 = starColors[starColorIdx]
            star.BorderSizePixel = 0
            star.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(2, 4), 0, math.random(2, 4))
            star.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, 0, 0)
            Instance.new("UICorner", star).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            
            TweenService:Create(star, TweenInfo.new(math.random(2, 4), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                Position = UDim2.new(star.Position.X.Scale, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(star, 4)
        end
        
        if rainMode ~= "OFF" then
            local targetParent = (rainMode == "UI") and MainFrame or ScreenParticlesGui
            local drop = Instance.new("Frame", targetParent)
            drop.BackgroundColor3 = rainColors[rainColorIdx]
            drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
            drop.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, math.random(8, 14))
            drop.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, 0, 0)
            
            TweenService:Create(drop, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                Position = UDim2.new(drop.Position.X.Scale, -15, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(drop, 0.6)
        end
    end
end)

-- Execution Loop (Speed, Jump, Bypass protection)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hum = char.Humanoid
        
        hum.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * speedMultiplier
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = baseJump * jumpMultiplier
        
        if spinbotActive and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(25), 0)
        end
    end
    
    if noclipEnabled and char then
        for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    if auraActive and char then
        for _, p in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Color = activeThemeColor
                p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Auto-Load Config on Character Respawn/Join
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    loadExistingConfig()
    workspace.Gravity = gravityVal
end)

-- UI Actions (Minimize & Close)
local hidden = false
HideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    hidden = not hidden
    ContentContainer.Visible = not hidden
    TabBar.Visible = not hidden
    if hidden then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 40)
        HideBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420)
        HideBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    workspace.Gravity = 196.2
    ScreenParticlesGui:Destroy()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
